paragraphs: Nechemyah, son-in-law of the Nasi's household.
Mentioned in Yoma 78a, where he said, “I saw R' Ami and R' Assi reach a channel of water and cross it wearing their footwear.”[^1][^2][^3]

notes.text: עח. gives 78a conventionally without a new named passage check.

עורקמא דמיא is a water channel/pool, not a place Orkama; מלבוש is wearing, not a place Malbush; the suffix refers to crossing the water, not conveying a person. Footwear is the preserved contextual interpretation reported by the prior consulted discussion, not an explicit noun in Hyman or a fresh source check here.

חתניה דבי נשיאה is son-in-law of the Nasi household, not the name Hatania. Machine חתגיה remains provenance, not an alternative admitted relationship. Both Ami/Assi title abbreviations remain R', while Nasi is the supplied household designation and Nechemyah untitled.
